day_local: Ullumi nalliuffik Saint Thérèse of the Child Jesus
greeting: Ataniup aqqutingitigut, Atap, Irniup, ammalu Tarningup Salumajup aqqani. Quanaulluni Ataniq Jesus Christ, piqatigiuqpalihaaliit.
penitential:
Ataniq, nalligijout, nalligijout.
Kristuq, nalligijout, nalligijout.
Ataniq, nalligijout, nalligijout.
psalm_response: Upperuvunga takuniarlunga Ataniup piujunik nunami inuurtut.
homily:
Job uqaqtuq, 'Pity me, pity me, O you my friends, for the hand of God has struck me!' Uqausiit, uqausiit, uqumaittut. Qaujimajavut taanna uqausiq, qaujimajavut uqumaittuq. Uqumaittuq, kisiani, taanna uqausiq, taanna uqausiq, uummammi saqquqpuq. Job, uqausiq uqaqtuq, 'But as for me, I know that my Vindicator lives, and that he will at last stand forth upon the dust.' Taanna uqausiq, taanna upperneq, inuusiup iluani qammanngilaq. 

Imaqa takujataraarpugut tusaajani, tusaajani inuusiup silataani, tusaajani inuusiup iluani. Job nalliuqtuq, nalliuqtuq uqumaittumik. Tusaajavut Job-up uqausiinik, 'Oh, would that my words were written down! Would that they were inscribed in a record: That with an iron chisel and with lead they were cut in the rock forever!' Job, uqausiq uqaqtuq, uqausiq quviasuttuq. Kisiani, Job-up uummanganik, upperneq saqquqpuq. 'My inmost being is consumed with longing.' 

Takuviuk inuusiq? Inuusiq ungahiktumut piumanngilaq. Benjamin Vo, 15-nik ukiuqaqtilluni, inuusiqaqtilluni, inuit takulaurtangit silataani. Benjamin, taanna inuusiq, taanna inuusiq, taanna inuusiq. Benjamin, taanna 'con chim airlines'-mik kinguvaqtaaq, taanna inuusiq, taanna inuusiq. Benjamin-up inuusia, taanna 'masterpiece-ngulluni', uummataup salumajunianik ammalu asijinik asujinik tatatitaulluni. Benjamin-up inuusia, 15-nik ukiuqaqtilluni, inuit takulaurtangit silataani: silatualuuniranga, mathematics-mi pialuktuuninga, coding-mi ammalu technology-mi qaujimaninga. Taakkua pitsiaqtut, silataani qaumajut. Kisiani, Benjamin-up inuusia sanningajuup ujaqqatut tomb-tut ippunngilaq. Ben-up uummanga light-vallaalaurpuq, open-vallaalaurpuq, free-vallaalaurpuq. Ben-up uummanga walk-laurpuq Ataniup aqqutingitigut with a pure, simple heart. 

Qaujimajavut Job-up uqausiinik ammalu Gospel-mi tusaajavut. Jesus appointed seventy-two other disciples whom he sent ahead of him in pairs to every town and place he intended to visit. 'Into whatever house you enter, first say, Peace to this household.' Peace. Peace. Peace. Tusaajavut Gospel-mi, Jesus-up uqausiinik. Ben, Ben-up inuusia, tusaajavut qanuq inuulauqtuq. Benjamin, taanna 15-nik ukiuqaqtilluni, qaujimajurli qanuq aannialunnik, qaujimajurli qanuq nalligijausimanik. Tusaajavut dad-up uqausiinik: Ben unniuqataalauqtuq dad-mut, quviasuktut, qaujimajavut qanuq Ben quviasulluni. Ben, taanna 'con chim airlines'-mik qajjaalauqtuq, qajjaalauqtuq quviasulluni, giggles-pallalauqtuq dad-mut. 

Alan ammalu Thao, ammalu Ryan. Ilissiklu uqumaittumik atuqtut. Qaujimajavut uqumaittuq, qaujimajavut silataani inuusiq. Kisiani, uqaqtuq Gospel-mi, 'Peace to this household.' Ben, taanna 'Banquet of Heaven'-mi, standing beside Saint Thérèse of the Child Jesus. Saint Thérèse, 'Little Flower', qaujimajurli qanuq love-mut. Ben ammalu Thérèse, standing together in the light of the Father. Ben-up inuusia, qaujimajavut, itiqtuq, salumajuq, upperluni. 

What can we carry out the door today? When your heart feels heavy, when the morning light comes in and you feel the empty chair, do not look only at the silence. Look up at the sky, just like Ben loved to watch airplanes soar, and remember that God's peace is real, God's Vindicator lives, and Benjamin Vo is safe in the Father's eternal embrace.
spiritual_communion: Ataniqturaq Jesus, upperuvunga illit Sacramenti Salumajumi piqatiqarvigijout. Asijinik asujinik asugijaqtuqallunga illit asigijara, uummammilu piumajut illit iluani inuuniaqtut. Uvanga, quviasuktuvunga illit uummammi inuuniarnissatut, kisiani uvaani tungaani illit piqatinngilaq. Taimaak, tiguvunga illit uummammi, uvaani salumajumi. Illit mianikillunga, ammalu illit piqatiginialuugit, ammalu aanniaqqunagu illit asugijaqtuqallunga. Amen.
closing: Ataniup asigijarninga ammalu tarninga salumajuq piqatiqalihaaliit illit hannauniarnissatut. Amen.
standing_petitions: Benjamin Vo ammalu tamarmi inuit tuquqtut, Ataniup qaumaningani inuuniaqullugit, ataniq tusaajavut.
Tamarmik uqumaittumik atuqtut, Ataniup qanuq nalligijarninga ammalu uqaqtauviniq tunniullugu, ataniq tusaajavut.

readings.label: Job 19:21-27
readings.text: Job said: Pity me, pity me, O you my friends, for the hand of God has struck me! Why do you hound me as though you were divine, and insatiably prey upon me? Oh, would that my words were written down! Would that they were inscribed in a record: That with an iron chisel and with lead they were cut in the rock forever! But as for me, I know that my Vindicator lives, and that he will at last stand forth upon the dust; Whom I myself shall see: my own eyes, not another’s, shall behold him, And from my flesh I shall see God; my inmost being is consumed with longing.

readings.label: Psalm 27:7-8a, 8b-9abc, 13-14
readings.text: R. I believe that I shall see the good things of the Lord in the land of the living. Hear, O LORD, the sound of my call; have pity on me, and answer me. Of you my heart speaks; you my glance seeks. R. I believe that I shall see the good things of the Lord in the land of the living. Your presence, O LORD, I seek. Hide not your face from me; do not in anger repel your servant. You are my helper: cast me not off. R. I believe that I shall see the good things of the Lord in the land of the living. I believe that I shall see the bounty of the LORD in the land of the living. Wait for the LORD with courage; be stouthearted, and wait for the LORD. R. I believe that I shall see the good things of the Lord in the land of the living.

readings.label: Luke 10:1-12
readings.text: Jesus appointed seventy-two other disciples whom he sent ahead of him in pairs to every town and place he intended to visit. He said to them, “The harvest is abundant but the laborers are few; so ask the master of the harvest to send out laborers for his harvest. Go on your way; behold, I am sending you like lambs among wolves. Carry no money bag, no sack, no sandals; and greet no one along the way. Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace to this household.’ If a peaceful person lives there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you. Stay in the same house and eat and drink what is offered to you, for the laborer deserves his payment. Do not move about from one house to another. Whatever town you enter and they welcome you, eat what is set before you, cure the sick in it and say to them, ‘The Kingdom of God is at hand for you.’ Whatever town you enter and they do not receive you, go out into the streets and say, ‘The dust of your town that clings to our feet, even that we shake off against you.’ Yet know this: the Kingdom of God is at hand. I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom on that day than for that town.”

day: Memorial of Saint Thérèse of the Child Jesus, Virgin and Doctor of the Church

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.
